name: ClaudeCodeMods
description: Claude Code mods by konsta95: function-hook plugins, starting with the ClaudeCodeStatusline bar as a function hook.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: ClaudeCodeStatusline as a function-hook mod: the status bar drawn in the hint line under the prompt, each segment revealing its details on hover, with /statusline-mod to pick the segments.

plugins.name: hidevalues
plugins.description: Hides high-entropy tokens and e-mail addresses in Bash results until hovered.

plugins.name: mod-settings
plugins.description: A /mods pane that lists the mods' visible settings, drafts edits and applies them, with presets, undo and observed hook previews.
